Name: Robin likes Building Materials
Author: Arrowhawkmods
Description:
This mod aims to right the great injustice that Robin does not appreciate good building materials!

What this mod changes:
[list]
[*]Robin now likes wood and stones
[*]Robin now Loves Hardwood
[/list]

Credit for the idea goes to my wonderful Girlfriend who pointed out it makes no sense Robin dislikes being given building materials and told me to make a mod so that she at least likes them. So here it is!

The mod is very lightweight and doesn't replace any code or event so I don't forsee any issues, but I'm not a coder and only made one mod before in my life so if anything comes up please let me know and I will see if I can fix it and learn something new!

Manifest.Name: Robin Like Buidling Materials
Manifest.Description: Makes Robin like wood and stone
